title: UH-1 helicopter
author: Rmutt
changes: A real UH-1 'Huey' helicopter flying by, its two big rotor blades going 'chop-chop-chop'. Trimmed to 9.80–12.70 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 1.5 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording (Sony PCM-D50). The 70 Hz high-pass trims measured low-frequency wind and rotor rumble.
